residual_risk: A board whose only claude-bg profile has no ended attempt in the newest 10 run records reads the full sample on every `hkb doctor` (10 REST calls) - bounded and reported, but it is the worst case; this repo hits it because claude-track has no recent attempts.

The sample is the newest 10 cards by updatedAt, so a profile whose attempts are all older than that is invisible to the check - deliberate (it answers about now, not about history), but a very quiet profile shows no finding rather than a warning.

results.summary:
hkb doctor now names the two things a `claude-bg` board could not tell you.

**(1) `profile <name> sessions`** — one finding per `claude-bg` profile that has ended an attempt on this board. A warning when NO ended attempt carries `session_id`, naming both causes: an hkb older than the recording (`npm i -g hkb-cli@latest && hkb init`), or a harness that is not stamping (`$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR`, the only thing a `claude --bg` worker can read its own identity from). Otherwise an ok line splitting verb-ended rows from the ones written off without a verb, so a blank column points at the mechanism that owns it. `spawn_failed`/`reclaimed`/`gave_up` and `synthetic` rows are never counted — no worker session ran, so a board of those must not warn about a hole that is not one.

**(2) `permission policy`** — one line. hkb's PreToolUse hook is inert on `claude-bg` (no `KB_TASK`) and on `trigger`, and never runs for Copilot/Codex, so on a default board the launch's own `--allowedTools` is the whole policy. It is an `ok`, not a warning: #133 is where that fork gets decided, and warning on every default board about an undecided choice would be noise.

**Cost.** Attempt rows live in one `<!-- kb-run -->` comment per card, so the sample is newest-first, capped at `SESSION_SAMPLE` (10), and stops as soon as every background profile has shown a session — a board recording normally pays for one read. Recently-closed cards are folded in (one extra query, no paging) because a *completed* attempt lives on a closed issue. `checkAgentLabels` and the new check share the one open-board query through the new `boardOnce`; `checkAgentLabels` gained an optional `board` argument and is otherwise unchanged.

**Docs.** `docs/harnesses.md` gained the "which layer is actually enforcing" table and lost the paragraph still saying an attempt without a verb records nothing — #137 corrected the wiki but not that file. README's worker-permissions row and spend paragraph point at both.

Draft PR #139. Verified live: `node bin/hkb.js doctor` on this board prints `✓ profile claude sessions  session recorded on 2/8 that filed a terminal verb` plus the permission-policy line, and `--json` stays parseable.

**For the next worker.** The wiki was already stale on five pages before this change (earlier commits, not this one) and this card's scope did not include it, so `/repolore:refresh` is still owed. #133 is still blocked/needs-human — if (b) ships, `policyLayers()` in `src/doctor.js` is the one place the `claude-bg` row flips to live.
